items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: But I met Candifo down there, and he took me to the airport

ctx.x: Candifo was a great trumpet player.

Yeah, and a great congo player.. But I met Candifo down there, and he took me to the airport and he couldn't speak any English and I couldn't speak any Spanish, and how we understood each other I don't know, but we did and we got to the airport and said goodbye to each other, and we rode all the way out there without saying a word.
I remember once, Cab tried to bring him back, before we ever got here, and they wouldn't let him leave.
